title: Google's New Cheapest AI Image Generator: Nano Banana 2 Lite
description:
Google just released Nano Banana 2 Lite, and it's a game changer for AI image generation. At just 0.00004 dollars per image, you can generate 1,000 images for only 4 cents! It's lightning-fast at 4 seconds per generation, and the quality matches the Pro version. If you use APIs in your workflow, this is the high-quality, low-cost solution you've been waiting for. 

In this video, we break down the math and show you why this is the best AI image generator for production and unlimited scaling.
